comments.author: yozhao101
comments.body: If we looked into this issue carefully, for the processes `bgpcfgd`, `bgpmon` and `lldpmgrd`, the python version was changed to `python3`. That is the reason why Monit continuously fired alerting messages into syslog.

comments.author: gechiang
comments.body:
@yozhao101  I think you are saying that inside monit_bgp file it is defined with using BGP as the sample:
```

check program bgp|bgpcfgd with path "/usr/bin/process_checker bgp /usr/bin/python /usr/local/bin/bgpcfgd"
    if status != 0 for 5 times within 5 cycles then alert repeat every 1 cycles

check program bgp|bgpmon with path "/usr/bin/process_checker bgp /usr/bin/python /usr/local/bin/bgpmon"
    if status != 0 for 5 times within 5 cycles then alert repeat every 1 cycles
```
This worked fine with python2.  but when the python version got changed to python3, the check program for MONIT above no longer match and causing MONIT not able to find the process matching with the exact wording and concluded that those processes failed...  with python3 these 2 processes is shown as following:
```
root        40  0.0  0.5  39696 23880 pts/0    S    06:22   0:00 /usr/bin/python3 /usr/local/bin/bgpcfgd
root        41  0.0  0.3  21980 15160 pts/0    S    06:22   0:00 /usr/bin/python3 /usr/local/bin/bgpmon
```
when you issue show services for bgp:
```
bgp     docker
---------------------------
USER       PID %CPU %MEM    VSZ   RSS TTY      STAT START   TIME COMMAND
root         1  0.1  0.5  28656 22692 pts/0    Ss+  06:22   0:01 /usr/bin/python2 /usr/bin/supervisord
root        21  0.0  0.4  22660 16620 pts/0    S    06:22   0:00 python /usr/bin/supervisor-proc-exit-listener --container-name bgp
root        25  0.0  0.0 225856  3640 pts/0    Sl   06:22   0:00 /usr/sbin/rsyslogd -n -iNONE
frr         29  0.4  0.6 515688 27144 pts/0    Sl   06:22   0:05 /usr/lib/frr/zebra -A 127.0.0.1 -s 90000000 -M fpm -M snmp
frr         30  0.0  0.1  43172  6060 pts/0    S    06:22   0:00 /usr/lib/frr/staticd -A 127.0.0.1
frr         31  0.3  1.4 333316 58524 pts/0    Sl   06:22   0:03 /usr/lib/frr/bgpd -A 127.0.0.1 -M snmp
root        40  0.0  0.5  39696 23880 pts/0    S    06:22   0:00 /usr/bin/python3 /usr/local/bin/bgpcfgd
root        41  0.0  0.3  21980 15160 pts/0    S    06:22   0:00 /usr/bin/python3 /usr/local/bin/bgpmon
root        42  0.1  0.1  82084  6156 pts/0    Sl   06:22   0:01 fpmsyncd
```

So the proper fix for this is to change monit_bgp as following:
```
check program bgp|bgpcfgd with path "/usr/bin/process_checker bgp /usr/bin/python3 /usr/local/bin/bgpcfgd"
    if status != 0 for 5 times within 5 cycles then alert repeat every 1 cycles

check program bgp|bgpmon with path "/usr/bin/process_checker bgp /usr/bin/python3 /usr/local/bin/bgpmon"
    if status != 0 for 5 times within 5 cycles then alert repeat every 1 cycles
```
For lldp we should also modify monit_lldp accordingly...
I have just tried changing this on str-dx010-acs-4 for the 3 problem daemons in monit_bgp and monit_lldp and restarted monit.
and I no longer see this being reported in syslog any more...

comments.author: yozhao101
comments.body: Thanks @gechiang, I will open a PR to fix this issue.

comments.author: gechiang
comments.body:
@yozhao101 The corresponding monit_files that need to be edited to use python3 are under:
sonic-buildimage/dockers/docker-fpm-frr/base_image_files/monit_bgp
sonic-buildimage/dockers/docker-lldp/base_image_files/monit_lldp
I was about to pull a PR for the changes but sure please go ahead and pull the PR and if I have the permission to approve it I will... You may want to include @lguohan for that PR just in case you require his approval for the merge request
I will go ahead assign this issue to you .  Please update this issue with your PR so that when the PR is merged, this issue is also automatically closed.
Thanks!

comments.body: Hi @yozhao101 @gechiang , I want to remind you that I have opened a PR fixing this, and your review is much appreciated!

linkedPullRequests.title: [monit] Fix status error due to shebang change
linkedPullRequests.author: lolyu
linkedPullRequests.body:
lldpmgrd, bgpcfgd, and bgpmon are reported error status not running due
to recent change of shebang to use `Python3`. Modifying the argument of
`process_checker` to follow this change.

fixes #5864 

Signed-off-by: Longxiang Lyu <lolv@microsoft.com>
